jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Brighton School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Brighton).

sources.note: Town of Brighton Annual Report 2023 (official town site), officers list: five School Directors (the electorate added two seats to the 16 V.S.A. section 423 default of three). No later district-sourced roster was obtainable: the district has no board page on the North Country SU site, and the town's 2024 report is flipbook-only. The post is modeled at five seats on the town's own last roster, with only the directors below verified as current.

North Country Supervisory Union 'Full Board' page (official): 'Brighton: Judy Castonguay, Moriah Gaboriault Alternate: Gayle Cornelius' -- the district's representatives to the supervisory union board, who are drawn from the district's own board (16 V.S.A. section 266). Castonguay and Gaboriault are recorded as current Brighton directors on this listing; Cornelius, listed as the alternate, is held pending a district-source roster.
